description: The sounds the previews play, by name: a two-bar groove to put an effect on (drums with ghost notes and a lilt, a bass, an electric piano and plucked notes), a four-bar trap hip-hop scene on a progression (a layered kick, a tuned 808 that ducks under it, a clap in a small room, metallic rolling hats, a haunting piano in F minor, bells and a pad, glued by a bus), a kick, a held chord, a voice with an s, wide chords, pink noise and pulses. Drawn once from the drum voices of the library and looped as a buffer.
name: demo-sound
